mapper.select: SELECT * FROM report WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND report_type = #{reportType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (report_type, target_id, user_id, reason_type, remark, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{reportType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{reasonType}, #{remark}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
